subject: Biology
title: Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants
summary: Flower sexual reproduction ki jagah hai. Stamen ka anther microsporogenesis se pollen grains (male gametophytes) banata hai; ovule megasporogenesis se embryo sac (female gametophyte) banata hai.

Pollination pollen ko stigma tak laata hai — hawa, paani ya animals se. Autogamy, geitonogamy aur xenogamy ke types hain; plants mein self-pollination se bachne ke outbreeding devices hain; pollen–pistil interaction compatibility tay karta hai.
Angiosperms mein double fertilisation hota hai: ek male gamete egg se judta hai (syngamy → zygote) aur doosra do polar nuclei se (triple fusion → primary endosperm nucleus, 3n).
Fertilisation ke baad ovule seed aur ovary fruit ban jaati hai; zygote se embryo banta hai. Khaas cases: apomixis, polyembryony aur parthenocarpy.

formulas.name: Anther structure
formulas.formula: bilobed, dithecous, tetrasporangiate;  wall layers: epidermis, endothecium, middle layers, tapetum (nourishes pollen; dense cytoplasm, often more than one nucleus)

formulas.name: Microsporogenesis
formulas.formula: microspore mother cell (2n) → meiosis → microspore tetrad (n) → pollen grains

formulas.name: Pollen grain
formulas.formula: exine of sporopollenin (most resistant organic material known; germ pores where absent) + intine (cellulose, pectin);  mature pollen: vegetative cell (large) + generative cell (small, divides into 2 male gametes)
formulas.note: 60% se zyada angiosperms mein pollen 2-celled stage par nikalta hai.

formulas.name: Ovule parts
formulas.formula: funicle, hilum, integuments, micropyle, chalaza, nucellus, embryo sac

formulas.name: Megasporogenesis and embryo sac
formulas.formula: megaspore mother cell → meiosis → 4 megaspores (one functional) → 3 mitotic divisions → 7-celled, 8-nucleate embryo sac (monosporic, Polygonum type)

formulas.name: Embryo sac cells
formulas.formula: micropylar: egg apparatus (egg + 2 synergids with filiform apparatus);  centre: central cell with 2 polar nuclei;  chalazal: 3 antipodals

formulas.name: Types of pollination
formulas.formula: autogamy (same flower);  geitonogamy (another flower, same plant — genetically like autogamy);  xenogamy (different plant — genetically different pollen)
formulas.mistake: Geitonogamy functionally cross-pollination hai (agent chahiye) par genetically self-pollination — confuse mat karna.

formulas.name: Chasmogamous vs cleistogamous
formulas.formula: chasmogamous: open flowers;  cleistogamous: never open, assured seed-set without pollinators (Viola, Oxalis, Commelina)

formulas.name: Pollinating agents
formulas.formula: wind (light non-sticky pollen, feathery stigma, one ovule — grasses, maize tassels);  water (Vallisneria, Hydrilla, Zostera — water hyacinth and water lily are insect/wind pollinated);  insects (large colourful, fragrant flowers, nectar)

formulas.name: Outbreeding devices
formulas.formula: pollen release and stigma receptivity not synchronised;  anther and stigma at different positions;  self-incompatibility;  unisexual flowers (castor, maize — prevents autogamy; papaya dioecious — prevents both autogamy and geitonogamy)

formulas.name: Double fertilisation
formulas.formula: syngamy: male gamete + egg → zygote (2n);  triple fusion: male gamete + 2 polar nuclei → PEN (3n)

formulas.name: Post-fertilisation changes
formulas.formula: ovule → seed;  integuments → seed coat;  ovary → fruit;  ovary wall → pericarp;  zygote → embryo;  PEN → endosperm
formulas.when: Floral parts ka kya hota hai.

formulas.name: Endosperm types
formulas.formula: free-nuclear (coconut water: thousands of free nuclei);  cellular (white kernel of coconut);  albuminous seeds keep endosperm (wheat, maize, castor);  non-albuminous use it up (pea, groundnut, bean)

formulas.name: Apomixis and polyembryony
formulas.formula: apomixis: seed without fertilisation (Asteraceae, grasses) — preserves hybrid characters;  polyembryony: more than one embryo (citrus, mango) from nucellar cells

examples.title: Ploidy table
examples.problem: Ploidy batao: nucellus, megaspore mother cell, functional megaspore, egg, endosperm, embryo.
examples.solution: Nucellus 2n, MMC 2n, megaspore n, egg n, endosperm 3n, embryo 2n.

examples.title: Embryo sac ki ginti
examples.problem: Typical embryo sac mein kitne cells aur nuclei?
examples.solution: 7 cells (3 antipodals, 2 synergids, 1 egg, 1 central cell) aur 8 nuclei (central cell mein 2 polar nuclei).

examples.title: Dono ko kaun rokta hai?
examples.problem: Kaunsa device autogamy aur geitonogamy dono rokta hai?
examples.solution: Dioecy (alag male aur female plants), jaise papaya.

examples.title: Bina seed ka fruit
examples.problem: Banana bina fertilisation ke fruit banata hai. Ise kya kehte hain?
examples.solution: Parthenocarpy — bina fertilisation fruit ka banna (growth hormones se bhi karwa sakte hain).

examples.title: Pollen storage
examples.problem: Crop breeding ke liye pollen grains kaise store karte hain?
examples.solution: Liquid nitrogen mein −196 °C par (pollen banks), jisse saalon tak viable rehte hain.

examples.title: Synergid ka role
examples.problem: Filiform apparatus ka kaam kya hai?
examples.solution: Synergids ke micropylar sire par cellular thickening jo pollen tube ko synergid ke andar guide karti hai.

topics.title: Pre-fertilisation events
topics.explain: Hormonal aur structural badlaav floral primordium ka differentiation karte hain. Inflorescence par floral buds aate hain; androecium aur gynoecium differentiate hote hain.

topics.title: Pollen viability and allergy
topics.explain: Rice aur wheat ke pollen 30 minute mein viability kho dete hain; Rosaceae, Leguminoseae aur Solanaceae ke kuch members mahino tak rakhte hain. Parthenium (carrot grass) ke pollen allergy aur bronchial bimaariyan karte hain. Pollen tablets food supplements ki tarah use hoti hain.

topics.title: Pollen–pistil interaction
topics.explain: Pistil compatible pollen pehchaan kar germination badhaata hai; pollen tube style se badhkar micropyle se ovule mein, phir synergid mein ghuskar do male gametes chhodti hai. Artificial hybridisation mein emasculation (anthers hataana) aur bagging use hote hain.

topics.title: Embryo development
topics.explain: Kuch endosperm banne ke baad zygote divide hota hai. Dicot embryo: do cotyledons wala embryonal axis, epicotyl (plumule) aur hypocotyl (radicle). Monocot embryo: ek cotyledon (scutellum), shoot apex ke aas-paas coleoptile aur radicle ke aas-paas coleorrhiza.

topics.title: Seeds
topics.explain: Seeds sexual reproduction ka aakhri product hain; dormancy unhe buri conditions mein bachati hai. Bacha hua persistent nucellus perisperm hai (black pepper, beet). Purane seeds bhi viable — lupine (~10,000 saal), date palm (~2000 saal).

topics.title: False fruits
topics.explain: Apple, strawberry aur cashew mein thalamus bhi fruit banane mein hissa leta hai — ye false fruits hain. True fruits sirf ovary se bante hain.

ratta: Apomixis: seed without fertilisation;  polyembryony: citrus, mango.
